newsitem.title: USA: Oxford guarantees interest on 30-day claims.
newsitem.headline: Oxford guarantees interest on 30-day claims.

text.p: Oxford Health Plans Inc said Thursday it will guarantee interest payments on New York provider claims it doesn't pay within thirty days.
Oxford said it adopted the policy as part of an agreement with New York Attorney General Dennis Vacco. It added it offers similar interest guarantees in New Jersey and Connecticut.
The policy will be effective for "clean" claims -- those with no inaccurate or incomplete information -- paid on or after July 25.
Oxford said its upgrading its computer system caused dealys in claims payments in late 1996 through mid-1997. It added it has reduced the backlog of claims that accumulated in the transition period.

Oxford said its upgraded computer system had the company pay more than 91 percent of clean claims received in June within 30 days. It added it voluntarily extended more than $271 million in cash advances to doctors since the beginning of the year.
The company's stock traded at 84-3/8 Thursday afternoon, down 3/8.
